summary: This page presents the SGX REIT's 2025 at-a-glance financial highlights in SGD millions, featuring a distributable income of $207.3 million (up 14.6% Y-O-Y), assets under management of $12.1 billion, and a distribution per unit of 7.035 cents (up 13.6% Y-O-Y). It also details portfolio occupancy rates of 94.8% for office and 98.2% for retail, alongside key metrics including net asset value per unit of $2.03, an aggregate leverage ratio of 41.5%, and all-in financing costs of 3.71% per annum.

This page of the Suntec REIT FY 2025 annual report contains a narrative letter to unitholders and management commentary on performance, but no schema-relevant data such as audited portfolio statements, financial tables, or specific tenant mix details.

This page presents the Financial Highlights for Suntec REIT, featuring a Consolidated Statement of Total Return reporting Gross Revenue of \$471.6m and Distribution Per Unit (DPU) of 7.035¢ for the financial year ended 31 December 2025, alongside a Consolidated Statement of Financial Position detailing Investment Properties at \$7,848.1m and Unitholders' Funds of \$6,008.7m as of that date. The section also includes a ten-year performance track record showing Assets Under Management rising to \$12.1 billion by Dec 2025 and Distributable Income reaching \$207.3 million in FY 25.

This page presents the Unit Performance table for Suntec REIT, detailing financial highlights such as unit prices (last done, highest, lowest), market capitalisation of SGD'000s, traded volume in million units, and DPU yield percentages alongside the Singapore Government 10-Year Bond yield. The content also includes a line chart illustrating the relative performance indices for SUN SP Equity, FSSTI Index, and FSTREI Index from December 2024 to December 2025, along with textual notes on total return since listing and constituent index memberships.

This page presents the Manager's Report for Suntec REIT, featuring a table of Net Property Income and income contribution by asset (top-N tenants/customers) alongside segment trade/tenant mix data. Key financial highlights include gross revenue of SGD'000 million ($471.6 million), distributable income of SGD'000 million ($207.3 million), and a distribution per unit (DPU) of 7.035 cents.

The report also includes text describing derivative fair values and an Assets Under Management table showing portfolio value trends from Dec 04 to Sep 25 in USD billions.

This page presents the Committed Office and Retail Occupancy tables for Suntec REIT's Singapore, Australia, and United Kingdom portfolios as of 31 December 2025, alongside Leasing Activities tables detailing new and renewal leases by property with tenant counts and net lettable area (NLA) in square feet.

This page presents the Property Portfolio table for Suntec REIT, detailing its high-quality commercial assets in Singapore, Australia, and the United Kingdom with a total net lettable area of 5,339,115 sq ft and a property valuation of S$11,830.1M. The report further specifies the portfolio composition across regions, including specific building names such as Suntec City, Nova Properties, and Southgate Complex, alongside tenant counts and occupancy rates.

This page presents the Office and Retail Portfolio Business Sector Analysis by Gross Rental Income as at 31 December 2025, alongside a text section on Diverse Tenant Mix detailing top-10 tenant contributions for both portfolios. No audited portfolio statements, total return tables, or financial highlights are present; instead, the data focuses on sector composition percentages and qualitative descriptions of tenant diversification.

This page presents the Top 10 tenants for the Office and Retail portfolios by Gross Rental Income as of 31 December 2025, detailing tenant names, business sectors, Net Leasable Area (NLA), and their respective percentages of total NLA and monthly gross rental income. The data is reported in SGD'000 based on exchange rates specified in the notes, with combined portfolio totals showing 21.6% of office NLA and 26.6% of retail NLA contributed by these top ten entities.

This page presents the lease expiry profile for Suntec REIT's office and retail portfolios as of 31 December 2025, featuring two tables detailing the percentage of Monthly Gross Rental Income and Net Lettable Area (NLA) expiring from FY 2026 to FY 2031 & Beyond. The content includes key metrics such as the weighted average lease expiry (WALE) of 3.80 years for the overall office portfolio and 2.42 years for the retail portfolio, along with renewal statistics indicating approximately 923,088 sq ft of office space were renewed or replaced in FY 2025.

This page presents Property Statistics for Suntec City as of 31 December 2025, detailing a Net Lettable Area of 2,119,747 sq ft with 657 tenants and a Market Valuation of \$5,986.7 million. This page presents the Suntec City Office Business Sector Analysis by Gross Rental Income as at 31 December 2025, with Technology, Media and Telecommunications leading at 35.6%, followed by a detailed table of 14 sectors and text confirming the top 10 tenants contributed 28.7% of gross office rental income for December 2025. It also includes the Lease Expiry Profile showing that 90.7% of Suntec City's office NLA is due to expire between FY 2026 and FY 2028, supported by a table detailing the percentage breakdown of Monthly Gross Office Rental Income and Office NLA from FY 2026 through FY 2031 & Beyond.

This page presents the Suntec City Retail Business Sector Analysis by Gross Rental Income as at 31 December 2025, with Food and Beverage leading at 42.2%, alongside a lease expiry profile showing 72.5% of total retail NLA expiring between FY 2026 and FY 2028.

This page contains the Capital Management sensitivity analysis table showing ICR impacts for 2025 and a list of Subsequent Events including distribution declarations, unit issuances, loan repayments, and the acquisition completion by Acrophyte Asset Management Pte Ltd. No audited Portfolio Statement, Profit or Loss table, gross revenue notes, Top-N tenants, trade mix, DPU highlights, or manager/trustee/sponsor information tables are present; however, Section 38 confirms the Group financial statements were authorised for issue on 24 March 2026.

This page presents the **Distribution of Unitholdings** and a **Top-N Tenants/Unitholders table**, reporting that 2,955,540,288 Units were outstanding as at 5 March 2026 with one class of voting rights. The twenty largest unitholders collectively hold 87.90% of the total units, led by Citibank Nominees Singapore Pte Ltd with 22.83%.

This page presents the Register of Substantial Unitholders as at 5 March 2026, detailing direct and deemed interests in units held by entities such as ESR Group Limited and major fund managers like Warburg Pincus. The data is reported in absolute unit counts without any specified reporting unit currency or scale (e.g., SGD'000 vs S$ million).

This page presents the **Statistics of Unitholders** and **Manager's Directors' Unitholdings** as at 5 March 2026 and 21 January 2026 respectively, detailing direct and deemed interests held by ESR Group Limited, MEGA BidCo group, Starwood Capital Group entities, Warburg Pincus funds, and specific directors. It also reports that approximately 53.3% of units are held in public hands, complying with SGX-ST Rule 723.

This page details the Interested Person Transactions for Suntec REIT, presenting a table of aggregate values (in S$'000) for transactions involving the Manager, Trustee, and associates of the controlling shareholder or CEO. The data covers both standard transactions under the Listing Manual/Property Fund Appendix and those conducted under unitholders mandate pursuant to Rule 920, excluding amounts below $100,000 each.

This page presents a table detailing the Manager's management fees paid in units, including base and performance fee components for Q1–Q4 2025 issued by Suntec REIT. It also provides subscription data as of 31 December 2025, non-deal roadshow expenses of S$23,000, and a percentage calculation of total operating expenses to net assets reported in SGD'000.

This page contains the Corporate Directory for the SGX REIT, listing contact details and key personnel for the Trustee (HSBC Institutional Trust Services), Manager (ESR Trust Management), Directors, Audit and Risk Committee, Nominating & Remuneration Committee, Company Secretary, Legal Adviser, Unit Registrar, Auditor (Ernst & Young LLP), and Stock Exchange quotation identifiers. No financial statements, portfolio data, tenant information, or distribution highlights are present on this page.
